blocks.text: ONE OR EIGHT took the long way around the world for the music video to “Yellow Brick Road”, the ending theme for Season 2 of the TV anime Black Clover. The eight members split into three teams, travelled from Mongolia’s sand dunes to the otherworldly scenery of Cappadocia in Turkey, and met again in Japan at the end. Written specifically for Black Clover Season 2, “Yellow Brick Road” also marks ONE OR EIGHT’s first song performed with Japanese lyrics. Its message of pursuing dreams alongside friends, even through uncertainty and personal struggles, reflects both the anime’s world and the group’s own […]...
